tools.name: weather_get
tools.description: Get current conditions and weather forecast for any location worldwide. Returns temperature, conditions, precipitation, and wind speed. Supports up to 7 days of forecast data.

location.description: City name, optionally with country or region for disambiguation (e.g. 'Norfolk, UK', 'Tokyo', 'Berlin, Germany', 'New York', 'Paris')

days.description: Number of forecast days to include (1-7, default 3)
